8 Days Rwenzori Mountain Trekking – Margherita Peak

Book This Tour

Overview

The Rwenzori Mountains — the mythical Mountains of the Moon — are one of Africa's most coveted and challenging trekking destinations. Summit Margherita Peak (5,109m), the third highest point in Africa, through alien Afro-alpine vegetation unlike anywhere on Earth.

Tour Highlights

Summit Margherita Peak (5,109m) — 3rd highest in Africa
Unique giant lobelia and groundsel Afro-alpine vegetation
Historic 'Mountains of the Moon' — the legendary source of the Nile
Glaciers and snowfields straddling the equator
UNESCO World Heritage Site trekking

Day-by-Day Itinerary

D1 Fort Portal – Nyakalengija (Trailhead) – Sine Hut (2,600m)

Drive from Fort Portal to Nyakalengija village at the park boundary. Begin trekking through cultivated land into montane forest. Arrive Sine Hut for dinner and overnight.

D2 Sine Hut – Nyabitaba Hut (2,651m)

Trek through dense montane forest alongside the Mubuku River. Spectacular forest birds and chance of forest elephant. Arrive Nyabitaba for night.

D3 Nyabitaba – John Matte Hut (3,414m)

Cross the Bujuku River and ascend steeply through heather and moorland. First views of the snow-capped peaks. John Matte Hut tonight.

D4 John Matte – Bujuku Hut (3,962m)

Trek through surreal giant senecio and lobelia forests. Arrive Bujuku Hut in the heart of the mountains with Margherita Peak dominating the skyline.

D5 Acclimatisation – Scott Elliot Pass (4,372m)

Acclimatisation day — climb to Scott Elliot Pass for stunning views. Return to Bujuku for overnight.

D6 Summit Margherita Peak (5,109m)

Early start for the technical summit ascent via Elena Hut and the glaciers. Summit Margherita Peak with views across Uganda and DRC. Descend to Kitandara Hut.

D7 Kitandara – Nyabitaba

Long descent day through the spectacular Bujuku Valley and back down through montane forest.

D8 Nyabitaba – Nyakalengija – Fort Portal

Final descent back to the trailhead. Transfer to Fort Portal for hot shower and celebration dinner. Certificates awarded.
